actualScienceFindings: Columns Aldehyd/Keton and both negative Keton labels read as unqualified group-wide rules, although terminal alpha-hydroxyketones can give positive results.
Fehling positive tube shows Cu2O solid appropriately; preserve precipitate versus homogeneous-solution distinction.
Original has dense reagent/apparatus text and repeated heating setups; candidate retains the 2x2 comparison while making the corrected concrete compounds and outcomes readable on narrow phone.
